```{r}
library(readxl)

# Modify patient ID
patient_id <- function(pid) {
  m <- str_match(pid, "^CAR-(\\d+)$")
  n <- as.integer(m[,2])
  ifelse(!is.na(n),
         paste("CAR", n, sep = "-"),
         NA_character_)
}

# load miRNA normalized expression
cart_mat <- read_xlsx("CAR_T_microRNA_expr_matrix.xlsx",
               sheet = "Normalizedcounts_deseq2"
               #sheet = "Raw_data"
)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("-", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)
cart_mat$miRNA <- gsub("/", "_", cart_mat$miRNA)

cart_id <- patient_id(colnames(cart_mat))
cart_id <- c(colnames(cart_mat)[1], cart_id[-1])
colnames(cart_mat) <- cart_id

cart_mat <- as.data.frame(cart_mat)
rownames(cart_mat) <- cart_mat$miRNA
cart_mat$miRNA <- NULL

# micro-RNA filtering
# Every microRNA with 6 (10%) patients more zeroes is removed
cart_microRNA <- cart_mat[rowSums(cart_mat==0) < 6, ]
dim(cart_microRNA)

cart_microRNA <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(cart_microRNA)))
cart_microRNA <- cart_microRNA[order(rownames(cart_microRNA)), ]
```

```{r}
# Clinical variables
clinic_cov <- read_xlsx("clinical_covariates.xlsx")
dim(clinic_cov)
# remove unused variables
clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[, -c(16, 23:32, 35:36)]
clinic_cov <- as.data.frame(clinic_cov)
colnames(clinic_cov) <- c("patient_id","sex",
                    "age60","histology",
                    "n_lines_preAferesi","pre_aferesi_status","bridge_infusion",
                    "PET_BRIDGING","ECOG_PRELD","stage",
                    "BULKY_PRELD","DLBCL_R_IPI_PRELD","MCL_MIPI_PRELD","CAR_T_type",
                    "CAR_T_PRODUCT", "CRS","ICANS","ICANS_ricat","LDH_PRELD",
                    "FERR_PRELD","PCR_PRELD", "ttp_status", "ttp_time")

clinic_cov$ttp_time[clinic_cov$ttp_status == "NA"] <- max(clinic_cov$ttp_time)
clinic_cov$ttp_status[clinic_cov$ttp_status == "NA"] <- "0"
clinic_cov$ttp_status <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$ttp_status)
# clinic_cov$ttp_time[clinic_cov$ttp_status == "0"] <- max(clinic_cov$ttp_time)

hist(clinic_cov$ttp_time, breaks = 20)
clinic_cov$patient_id <- patient_id(clinic_cov$patient_id)

clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[order(clinic_cov$patient_id), ]
# sex F = 1, M = 0
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="F"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$sex[clinic_cov$sex=="M"] <- "0"
# histology PMBCL = 0, LBCL = 1, MCL = 2
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="PMBCL"] <- "0"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="LBCL"] <- "1"
clinic_cov$histology[clinic_cov$histology=="MCL"] <- "2"
clinic_cov$histology <- as.numeric(clinic_cov$histology)
clinic_cov$ICANS <- NULL
clinic_cov$CAR_T_type <- NULL
clinic_cov$DLBCL_R_IPI_PRELD <- clinic_cov$MCL_MIPI_PRELD <- clinic_cov$PET_BRIDGING <- NULL
clinic_cov <- clinic_cov[clinic_cov$BULKY_PRELD!="ND",]

cart_ttp_cox <- cart_microRNA[rownames(cart_microRNA) %in% clinic_cov$patient_id, ]
cart_ttp_cox <- cbind(clinic_cov, cart_ttp_cox)

cart_ttp_cox$split <- paste(cart_ttp_cox$CAR_T_PRODUCT, cart_ttp_cox$ttp_status, sep = "_")
cart_ttp_cox$split[cart_ttp_cox$split=="1_0"] <- "cart1_0"
cart_ttp_cox$split[cart_ttp_cox$split=="0_0"] <- "cart0_0"
cart_ttp_cox$split[cart_ttp_cox$split=="0_1"] <- "cart0_1"
cart_ttp_cox$split[cart_ttp_cox$split=="1_1"] <- "cart1_1"
```

# Cox

```{r}
split <- function(data) {
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = data$split, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  ll <- list(discovery = data[inTrain, ], test = data[-inTrain, ])
  return(ll)
}

train_valid <- function(discovery){ 
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = discovery$split, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  train <- discovery[inTrain, ]
  train$patient_id <- NULL
  train$split <- NULL
  
  train_surv <- Surv(train$ttp_time, train$ttp_status)
  train$ttp_status <- NULL
  train$ttp_time <- NULL

  valid <- discovery[-inTrain,]
  valid$patient_id <- NULL
  valid$split <- NULL
  
  ll <- list(train = train, train_surv = train_surv, valid = valid)
  return(ll)
}

set.seed(333)
split1 <- split(cart_ttp_cox)
discovery <- split1$discovery
test <- split1$test

n <- 100000
split2 <- replicate(n, train_valid(discovery), simplify = FALSE)
train1 <- lapply(1:n, function(i) split2[[i]][[1]])
valid1 <- lapply(1:n, function(i) split2[[i]][[3]])
train_surv <- lapply(1:n, function(i) split2[[i]][[2]])
```

```{r}
set.seed(333)
foldid <- sample(rep(seq(5), length.out = nrow(train1[[1]])))
elastic_net <- function(train, train_surv, foldid) {
  cv <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(train), train_surv, family =  "cox", foldid = foldid, alpha = 0.3)
  return(cv)
}

cv_glmnet1 <- lapply(1:n, function(i)  elastic_net(train1[[i]], train_surv[[i]], foldid))

accuracy_dist <- function(cv_glmnet, valid) {
  y_real <- valid$ttp_status
  valid$ttp_status <- NULL
  valid$ttp_time <- NULL
  
  pred <- predict(cv_glmnet, newx = as.matrix(valid), type = "link", s = "lambda.min")
  pred <- as.data.frame(pred)
  y_pred <- ifelse(pred > 0, "0", "1")
  colnames(y_pred) <- c("y_pred")

  tab <- table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels = 0:1))
  accuracy <- (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2]) / (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2] + tab[1, 2] + tab[2, 1]) 
  return(accuracy)
}

valid_accuracy <- lapply(1:n, function(i) accuracy_dist(cv_glmnet1[[i]], valid1[[i]]))

hist(do.call(rbind, valid_accuracy), breaks = 20)

```

```{r}
coef_ll <- function(cv_glmnet) {
  coef <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_glmnet, s = "lambda.min")))
  coef$var <- rownames(coef)
  coef <- coef[abs(coef$`1`) > 0, ]
  coef <- data.frame(var = coef$var)
  return(coef)
}

df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(cv_glmnet1, function(x) coef_ll(x))))
df <- as.data.frame(table(df))
df <- df[order(df$Freq, decreasing = TRUE ), ]
colnames(df) <- c("var", "times")
df$freq <- 100*round(df$times/n, 2)
df$type <- as.character(df$var)
df$type[grep("hsa", df$var)] <- "mirna"
df$type[df$type != "mirna"] <- "clinic"
df <- df[df$freq>=10,]

ggplot(df, aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=freq, fill=type)) + geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=5))

ggplot(df[df$freq>=20,], aes(x=reorder(var, freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=freq, fill=type)) + geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=15))

```
